name: BuildingConnected
summary: Autodesk's bid network. GCs send invitations to bid and level the returns; subcontractors receive invitations and manage bids from a bid board.
differentiator: Priced by who sends the invitation. GCs fund the platform on custom quotes while subcontractors can respond for free, so it is the default for subs chasing large GCs and a poor fit for a small GC that sends a handful of invitations a year. Prequalification and financial-risk data (TradeTapp) are built in, which is the feature to compare against Procore and SmartBid.
pricing: Not published. Third-party sources report $3,600 to $5,000+ per year for GCs on custom quotes, and some GCs report paying around $22,000 per year. Subcontractors can receive and answer invitations free; Bid Board Pro pricing is not published.
whoPays: GC pays; subs respond free (Bid Board Pro is a paid upgrade)
bestFor: Subcontractors invited by large GCs, and GCs with steady sub volume and a budget for a custom quote.
skipIf: You need a published price before talking to sales.
